notes: Player and placeholders: past-tense verbs and adjectives agree in gender in Ukrainian, so the player, other players and {name} are never the subject of a past-tense verb or adjective; present tense, impersonal forms (отримано, видалено) or a colon are used instead.
Placeholders stay in the nominative: after a colon, in apposition (гравцем {arg1}) or in «» quotes for Alliance/Gang names; nothing is attached to a placeholder.
Plurals use one/few/many/other per Intl.PluralRules("uk"); other (fractions) uses the genitive singular.
The legal, support and account pages address the reader as ви (polite plural), which is also gender-neutral in the past tense.
Generated names are noun-first (generatedNames: noun-first): second part is a nominative noun, first part an invariant genitive noun (Пік + Грому = Пік Грому, Клинок + Близнюків = Клинок Близнюків).
Japanese names are transliterated into Cyrillic in the common practical style (Кайто, Такеда, Хоші, Шинобі); Kage is Каґе.
Ukrainian is Cyrillic, outside the bundled Latin-1 fonts: it needs the system font stack like other non-Latin scripts.
Japan statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are translated into Ukrainian, keeping the draft notices; the support page keeps the Japanese titles as links.
